title: helper2
description: helper2.ai public app (application="helper2"): HTTP, federated search and sources, AI guide. The Scout, enrichment and the embedding indexer: dashboard helper2-backoffice. Meters: ADR 0009.

panels.title: Partial searches
panels.description: Share of searches over the last hour where at least one source failed or timed out.

panels.title: Guide budget left
panels.description: Model calls left today under the daily cap (ADR 0032).

panels.title: Search p95
panels.description: helper2.search.latency, the whole fan-out, over the last hour. Budget 3 s at p95 (performance baseline).

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application="helper2",environment="$environment",uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Search latency p50 / p95
panels.description: helper2.search.latency over all pods, from histogram buckets.

panels.title: Source latency p95
panels.description: helper2.source.latency per source over all pods and outcomes, from histogram buckets. Skipped sources and fresh cache hits record no latency.

panels.title: Outbound HTTP errors by host
panels.description: Source and collector calls; status CLIENT_ERROR / IO_ERROR included.

panels.title: Translation budget remaining
panels.description: Search query translations left under today's cap (helper2.search.daily-translations, UTC day). At 0 non-English queries run untranslated.

panels.title: Rate-limit decisions in memory (Redis down)
panels.description: helper2.rate-limit.fallback: per-client limits decided in one replica's memory because Redis was unavailable, so each replica allows the full limit. Should stay 0.

panels.title: Ask latency (mean)
panels.description: No buckets on helper2.guide.ask: mean = sum/count, plus Micrometer's rolling max.

panels.title: Answer cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of guide questions answered from the cache: exact key, or a similar question read the same way (ADR 0032).

panels.title: Model call p95 by step / model
Model calls by outcome
panels.description: A retry is a second sample. Outcomes: ok, rate_limited, unavailable, parse_error, error.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Only when the provider reports usage.

panels.title: Questions the model did not answer: shared, client quota, network quota, timeout
panels.description: shared: an identical question was already running and its answer was reused. client_quota: the asker's daily questions were used up, answered from search only (notice GUIDE_DAILY_QUOTA). network_quota: the asker's network (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /56) used up its daily questions, answered from search only (notice GUIDE_NETWORK_QUOTA); a steady count on normal days says the network cap is too low. timeout: the question passed helper2.guide.question-deadline and was cancelled (504).

panels.title: Time to first useful event by intent
panels.description: helper2.guide.first_useful: from the stream request to its first retrieved or clarify event (ADR 0009). Targets: p50 3 s, p95 8 s (alert Helper2GuideFirstUsefulSlow). Cached and shared answers are not timed.

panels.title: Scrape
panels.description: 1 = Alloy reaches the management port (8081). 0 or empty: pod down, or the NetworkPolicy blocks the observability namespace.

panels.title: Container memory vs limit
panels.description: The limit is 1Gi: the JVM heap plus metaspace, threads and buffers must fit, or the kernel OOM-kills the pod.

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: From the structured (logstash JSON) app log, shipped by the cluster Alloy.
